newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tupperware estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tupperware estimates cut.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial Inc on Wednesday said it reduced its 1997 earnings estimate for Tupperware Corp to $2.60 a share from $2.80 and its estimate for 1998 to $2.97 from $3.10.
-- Mesirow said the strength of the U.S. dollar, which could hamper earnings growth, prompted the revision for 1997.

-- The revision for 1998 assumes trend-line growth of 14 percent off of a trough of earnings in 1997, Mesirow said. The 1998 estimate is preliminary and subject to revision based on the company's fundamental outlook and the value of the dollar entering 1998.
-- Shares of Tupperware, which makes and markets household products, were off 1/2 at 33 early Wednesday afternoon.
